name: ButtonGroup
description: Groups related controls into a compact segmented surface.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Defines group items programmatically when declarative noora-button-group-item children are not used.

events.name: noora-select
events.type: CustomEvent<{ index: number; item: Record<string, unknown>; value: unknown }>
events.description: Emitted when an enabled group item is selected.

notes: Use noora-button-group-item children for declarative groups.
The items property remains available for data-driven rendering.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Button groups range from small to large.

examples.title: Icon configurations
examples.description: Compare labeled controls with icons, icon-only controls, and a mixture of both.
examples.markup:
<noora-button-group size="medium">
  <noora-button-group-item icon-left="chevron_left">Previous</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item icon-left="chevron_left" icon-right="chevron_right">Both</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item icon-right="chevron_right">Next</noora-button-group-item>
</noora-button-group>

<noora-button-group size="medium">
  <noora-button-group-item icon="chevron_left" icon-only aria-label="Previous"></noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item icon="chevron_right" icon-only aria-label="Next"></noora-button-group-item>
</noora-button-group>

<noora-button-group size="medium">
  <noora-button-group-item icon="chevron_left" icon-only aria-label="Previous"></noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item>Page 1</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item>Page 2</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item icon="chevron_right" icon-only aria-label="Next"></noora-button-group-item>
</noora-button-group>

examples.title: States
examples.description: Compare a partially disabled group with a fully disabled group.

examples.title: Practical examples
examples.description: Use groups for pagination controls and view switching.
examples.markup:
<noora-button-group size="medium">
  <noora-button-group-item icon="chevron_left" icon-only aria-label="Previous"></noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item selected>1</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item>2</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item>3</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item icon="chevron_right" icon-only aria-label="Next"></noora-button-group-item>
</noora-button-group>

<noora-button-group size="small">
  <noora-button-group-item selected>List</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item>Grid</noora-button-group-item>
  <noora-button-group-item>Card</noora-button-group-item>
</noora-button-group>
